items.title: 〈能源盤後〉油價挫逾3% 跌破100美元！美伊外交曙光現 沙烏地出口部分恢復
items.title_en: Energy After-Hours: Oil Prices Drop Over 3% Below $100 as US‑Iran Diplomatic Hopes Rise and Saudi Exports Partially Resume
paras: 油價周一(21日)大幅走低，布蘭特原油 (Brent)期貨一度跌破每桶100美元，創9月9日以來最低，市場一方面押注美伊外交可能取得進展，另一方面則關注沙烏地阿拉伯原油出口在東西管線遭攻擊後逐步恢復。儘管葉門胡塞武裝周末仍對沙烏地首都利雅德及紅海沿岸的延布發動攻擊，但目前尚未造成足以中斷大規模原油供應的影響，投資人因此降低部分地緣政治風險溢價。
布蘭特11月期貨周一收跌3.53美元或3.4%，報每桶100.34美元；盤中最低觸及99.51美元，為9月9日以來最低。美國西德州中級原油(WTI)10月期貨下跌4.52美元或4.51%，收報95.78美元，該合約將於周二(22日)到期；11月WTI則報92.47美元。兩大指標油價均創9月9日以來最低水準。
油價下跌的主要推力之一，是市場重新押注美國與伊朗可能透過外交途徑降低衝突。聯合國大會本周在紐約舉行，美國總統川普表示對與伊朗總統馬蘇德．佩澤希齊揚會面持開放態度；伊朗方面則已透過中間人傳遞談判條件。市場因此預期，若本周出現外交突破，可能降低中東供應中斷風險，進而削弱油價此前因戰事形成的風險溢價。
KCM Trade首席市場分析師Tim Waterer表示，市場似乎正在因期待本周可能出現降低美伊衝突的外交途徑，而從油價中移除部分風險溢價。不過，外交希望最終能否實現仍有待觀察。
除了外交因素，沙烏地原油出口逐步恢復也是壓低油價的重要因素。9月13日的無人機攻擊導致沙烏地東西原油管線受損，沙烏地因此停止部分經由紅海延布港的原油裝載，並取消部分對歐洲客戶的原油貨運安排。不過，沙烏地隨後增加東部波斯灣出口碼頭的裝載量，將更多原油轉往亞洲市場。
TankerTrackers.com數據顯示，沙烏地9月20日在波斯灣拉斯坦努拉港向7艘超大型油輪(VLCC)裝載約1400萬桶原油，顯示受到東西管線中斷影響的出口活動正出現部分恢復跡象。Reuters看到的衛星影像也顯示，周日有7艘油輪停靠在拉斯坦努拉港附近。
根據JPMorgan Chase (JPM-US)分析師9月18日的報告，衛星數據顯示，過去6天沙烏地經荷姆茲海峽運輸的原油平均達到每日約290萬桶，明顯高於8月約70萬桶。這意味著在東西管線受損後，沙烏地正在透過波斯灣港口及荷姆茲海峽重新安排出口路線。
此外，Reuters援引航運與衛星資料指出，沙烏地9月原油出口量可能已較8月大幅回升。Kpler初步數據顯示，沙烏地9月至今原油出口量超過每日400萬桶，遠高於8月約240萬桶。8月出口量則是至少2013年以來最低水準之一。
沙烏地也已安排更多原油透過波斯灣出口。交易人士此前向Reuters透露，沙烏地本月及下月計畫從拉斯坦努拉港出口約6000萬桶原油，再透過船對船轉運方式經由阿曼蘇哈爾港運輸。這項安排顯示，沙烏地正積極調整物流路線，以降低東西管線遭破壞對整體出口能力的影響。
不過，油市供應風險並未完全消失。胡塞武裝周六(19日)宣稱以飛彈及無人機攻擊沙烏地首都利雅德的「敏感目標」，同時宣稱攻擊紅海城市延布的一處沙烏地阿美設施。沙烏地方面表示防空系統攔截了一枚射向利雅德的飛彈；目前沒有證據顯示這些攻擊已造成足以大幅削減沙烏地原油產量或出口量的損害。
胡塞武裝的攻擊仍是市場密切關注的風險，因為沙烏地近期部分出口已轉向波斯灣及荷姆茲海峽。這意味著，如果區域衝突進一步升高並影響荷姆茲海峽航運，原本作為替代路線的出口通道本身也可能受到威脅。JPMorgan分析師指出，近期中東原油流量仍比市場最初擔心的情況強勁，但供應路線的改變也使荷姆茲海峽的重要性重新升高。
另一方面，中國也開始介入降低區域能源供應風險。沙烏地先前要求北京協助遏制胡塞武裝對沙烏地能源設施的攻擊，中國則要求伊朗協助控制胡塞武裝的相關行動。市場因此也關注中國外交斡旋是否能降低紅海及波斯灣地區進一步擴大的風險。
油價近期的跌勢也反映市場對實際供應量的重新評估。9月中旬沙烏地東西管線遭攻擊後，市場一度擔心中東供應進一步受阻，推動布蘭特原油價格升至每桶約108美元附近。不過，隨著沙烏地增加波斯灣出口、部分油輪重新裝載，以及市場預期外交可能降低衝突風險，油價此前累積的地緣政治溢價開始回吐。
荷姆茲海峽仍是油市最重要的風險焦點之一。Reuters此前報導，9月中旬荷姆茲海峽商業船舶通行量一度降至每日個位數，低於10天平均約14艘，顯示區域衝突已對航運造成實質影響。沙烏地近期提高經荷姆茲海峽出口的同時，也意味著全球市場對該海峽暢通程度的依賴重新升高。
市場目前因此形成兩股力量拉鋸。一方面，如果美伊外交取得突破、沙烏地出口持續恢復，原油供應中斷風險可能進一步下降，油價可能繼續消化此前累積的地緣政治溢價；另一方面，如果胡塞武裝攻擊升級，或伊朗與美國的外交進程再次陷入停滯，荷姆茲海峽航運受到干擾，供應風險仍可能迅速重新推升油價。
此外，WTI 10月期貨即將到期也放大了周一的價格波動。市場人士指出，部分交易者可能提前將即將到期的10月合約轉倉至11月合約，這也是WTI跌破每桶100美元後跌幅明顯擴大的因素之一。11月WTI期貨周一報每桶92.47美元，與即將到期的10月合約形成明顯價差。
對全球能源市場而言，近期油價走勢已從單純反映戰事風險，轉向同時評估實際原油流量、沙烏地出口恢復程度以及美伊外交前景。只要沙烏地能維持每日逾400萬桶的出口規模，且荷姆茲海峽航運沒有出現新的重大中斷，市場供應壓力便有望較此前預期緩和；但若攻擊擴大至關鍵能源設施或主要航運通道，供應風險仍可能迅速重新反映在油價上。
paras_en: Oil prices fell sharply on Monday (the 21st), with Brent crude futures briefly slipping below $100 a barrel, the lowest since September 9. The market is betting on possible progress in US‑Iran diplomacy while also watching the gradual recovery of Saudi Arabian crude exports after the east‑west pipeline was attacked. Although Yemen’s Houthi forces launched attacks over the weekend on Saudi Arabia’s capital Riyadh and the Red Sea port of Yanbu, they have not yet caused disruptions large enough to halt major crude supplies, prompting investors to trim some geopolitical risk premiums.

Brent November futures closed down $3.53, or 3.4%, at $100.34 a barrel on Monday; intraday lows hit $99.51, the lowest since September 9. U.S. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) October futures fell $4.52, or 4.5%, to $95.78, with the contract expiring on Tuesday the 22nd; November WTI was at $92.47. Both benchmark crude prices hit their lowest levels since September 9.

One of the main drivers of the price decline was the market’s renewed bet that the United States and Iran could lower tensions through diplomatic channels. The United Nations General Assembly met in New York this week, and U.S. President Trump said he was open to meeting Iran’s President Masoud Pezeshk; Iran has conveyed negotiation conditions through intermediaries. The market therefore expects that a diplomatic breakthrough this week could reduce the risk of Middle‑East supply disruptions and erode the war‑driven risk premium that had been supporting oil prices.

Tim Waterer, chief market analyst at KCM Trade, said the market appears to be stripping some risk premium from oil prices as investors anticipate diplomatic avenues that could de‑escalate the US‑Iran conflict this week. However, whether diplomatic hopes will materialise remains to be seen.

In addition to diplomatic factors, the gradual restoration of Saudi crude exports is also pressuring prices lower. A drone strike on September 13 damaged Saudi’s east‑west pipeline, prompting the kingdom to halt some loading at the Red Sea port of Yanbu and cancel part of its crude shipments to European customers. Saudi then increased loading at its eastern Persian Gulf export terminals, shifting more crude to Asian markets.

Data from TankerTrackers.com show that on September 20 Saudi loaded about 14 million barrels of crude onto seven VLCCs at Ras Tanura in the Persian Gulf, indicating that export activity affected by the east‑west pipeline outage is beginning to recover. Satellite imagery seen by Reuters also showed seven tankers moored near Ras Tanura on Sunday.

According to a September 18 JPMorgan Chase (JPM‑US) analyst report, satellite data indicate that over the past six days Saudi crude transiting the Hormuz Strait averaged about 2.9 million barrels per day, well above the roughly 0.7 million barrels per day in August. This suggests that after the pipeline damage, Saudi is rerouting exports through Persian Gulf ports and the Hormuz Strait.

Furthermore, Reuters, citing shipping and satellite data, noted that Saudi crude exports in September may have rebounded sharply from August levels. Preliminary Kpler data show Saudi’s September export rate exceeding 4 million barrels per day, far above the roughly 2.4 million barrels per day in August, which was one of the lowest since at least 2013.

Saudi has also arranged more crude to be shipped via the Persian Gulf. Traders told Reuters the kingdom plans to export about 60 million barrels from Ras Tanura this month and next, then transfer the cargo ship‑to‑ship through Oman’s Sohar port. The arrangement shows Saudi is actively adjusting logistics to mitigate the impact of the east‑west pipeline damage on overall export capacity.

Nevertheless, supply risks have not vanished. The Houthi rebels claimed on Saturday (the 19th) to have attacked “sensitive targets” in Riyadh with missiles and drones, and also struck a Saudi Aramco facility in Yanbu on the Red Sea. Saudi officials said air‑defence systems intercepted a missile aimed at Riyadh; there is no evidence that the attacks have caused damage sufficient to markedly cut Saudi crude production or exports.

Houthi attacks remain a closely watched risk because Saudi has recently shifted part of its exports to the Persian Gulf and the Hormuz Strait. This means that if regional fighting escalates and disrupts Hormuz shipping, the alternative route itself could be threatened. JPMorgan analysts note that recent Middle‑East crude flows remain stronger than initially feared, but the shift in supply routes also raises the strategic importance of the Hormuz Strait.

On the other hand, China has begun to intervene to reduce regional energy‑supply risks. Saudi previously asked Beijing to help curb Houthi attacks on its energy facilities, and China has asked Iran to help restrain Houthi actions. Markets are therefore watching whether Chinese diplomatic mediation can lower the risk of a broader escalation in the Red Sea and Persian Gulf.

The recent oil‑price decline also reflects a reassessment of actual supply volumes. After the mid‑September attack on Saudi’s east‑west pipeline, markets briefly feared further Middle‑East supply constraints, pushing Brent up to around $108 a barrel. As Saudi increased Persian Gulf exports, some tankers re‑loaded, and the market priced in the possibility that diplomacy could lower conflict risk, the geopolitical premium built into prices began to unwind.

The Hormuz Strait remains one of the oil market’s key risk focal points. Reuters previously reported that in mid‑September commercial vessel traffic through Hormuz fell to single‑digit daily counts, well below the ten‑day average of about 14 ships, showing that regional fighting has materially affected shipping. Saudi’s recent increase in Hormuz‑routed exports also means global markets are once again more dependent on the strait’s openness.

The market is therefore being pulled by two opposing forces. On the one hand, if US‑Iran diplomacy breaks through and Saudi exports keep recovering, the risk of supply disruption could fall further and oil prices may continue to digest the previously accumulated geopolitical premium. On the other hand, if Houthi attacks intensify or the US‑Iran diplomatic process stalls again, Hormuz shipping could be disrupted and supply risk could quickly push prices higher again.

In addition, the imminent expiry of the October WTI contract amplified Monday’s price volatility. Traders noted that some participants may have rolled their positions from the expiring October contract into the November contract ahead of expiry, which helped widen the drop after WTI slipped below $100 a barrel. November WTI futures were at $92.47 on Monday, creating a clear spread with the near‑term contract.

For the global energy market, recent oil‑price movements have shifted from merely reflecting war‑risk to also weighing actual crude flows, the extent of Saudi export recovery, and the outlook for US‑Iran diplomacy. As long as Saudi can sustain daily exports above 4 million barrels and Hormuz shipping remains uninterrupted, supply pressure should ease relative to earlier expectations; however, if attacks expand to critical energy facilities or major shipping lanes, supply risk could quickly re‑enter oil prices.

items.title: 川習會前有新大單？波音先替市場期待降溫
items.title_en: New big order before Trump‑Xi meeting? Boeing tempers market expectations
paras: 美國貿易代表葛里爾(Jamieson Greer)周一(21日)表示，中國正在推進今年5月宣布採購200架波音(BA-US)飛機的承諾，但他並未暗示，在美國總統川普與中國國家主席習近平本周會晤前，中方即將公布額外訂單。
葛里爾接受《福斯新聞》(Fox News)訪問時表示，供中國航空公司採購的波音飛機中，約140架目前「進展良好」，另有10架正在把採購內容落實為書面訂單。不過，他並未進一步說明其餘飛機的談判進度或交付時間。
川普5月曾表示，中國最終可能把波音採購規模擴大至最多750架，引發市場期待本周美中領袖會晤期間可能公布追加訂單。
不過，波音執行長歐特柏格(Kelly Ortberg)上周淡化相關預期。他表示，未來仍可能陸續增加訂單，但將由各家航空公司依照自身步調決定何時及如何對外宣布。歐特柏格5月曾形容，中國承諾採購的200架飛機只是潛在大型交易的「首批訂單」。
paras_en: US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said on Monday (21st) that China is moving forward with its commitment announced in May to purchase 200 Boeing (BA-US) aircraft, but he did not indicate that China will announce an additional order before the meeting this week between US President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping.

In an interview with Fox News, Greer said that of the Boeing planes intended for Chinese airlines, about 140 are currently “progressing well,” and another 10 are being formalized into written orders. However, he did not provide further details on the negotiation status or delivery timeline for the remaining aircraft.

In May, Trump said China could eventually expand the Boeing purchase to as many as 750 aircraft, fueling market hopes that an extra order might be announced during this week’s US‑China leaders’ summit.

Boeing CEO Kelly Ortberg downplayed those expectations last week. He said that additional orders may still come over time, but each airline will decide on its own schedule when and how to announce them publicly. Ortberg had described in May that the 200‑aircraft commitment from China was only the “first batch” of a potentially large deal.

items.title: AI真失控怎麼辦？川普：必要時讓司法部出手
items.title_en: What to Do If AI Gets Out of Control? Trump: Let the Justice Department Step In If Needed
paras: 美國總統川普(Donald Trump)周一(21日)表示，美國司法部(DOJ)及其他執法機構必要時將介入約束人工智慧(AI)風險，但他不會因此阻礙產業發展，強調美國必須維持對中國及其他國家的領先優勢。
川普在自家社群平台Truth Social發文表示，「無論誰贏得AI，誰就會勝出」，美國目前領先中國與其他國家，他將確保這項優勢延續。川普形容，AI帶來的影響將超越工業革命甚至網際網路，因此不會壓抑其成長。
針對AI可能引發的安全風險，川普表示政府將保持謹慎，並稱美國擁有司法部及其他執法機構，必要時可以控制局面。他強調，自己只會鼓勵AI或「超級智慧(SI)」發展。川普9月14日也曾發文稱，政府已對相關企業掌握強大的刑事及監管權力。
川普再次淡化AI潛在危險之際，Anthropic研究員考克森(Jacob Coxon)日前辭職，警告Anthropic與OpenAI正在利用這項技術「拿人類性命下注」。川普過去兩周則多次把AI風險形容為一場「騙局」。
考克森發出警告後，Anthropic執行長阿莫戴(Dario Amodei)、OpenAI執行長阿特曼(Sam Altman)、SpaceX執行長馬斯克(Elon Musk)，以及Google DeepMind董事長哈薩比斯(Demis Hassabis)均呼籲放慢AI開發速度，並要求聯邦政府加強監督。
不過，白宮至今大致採取寬鬆的AI監管方式。川普6月簽署的行政命令僅提出較寬鬆的審查架構，要求企業自願與政府合作評估受涵蓋的前沿AI模型，並在產品廣泛發布前最多30天，讓政府取得模型進行評估。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump said on Monday (the 21st) that the Department of Justice (DOJ) and other law‑enforcement agencies will intervene to curb AI risks when necessary, but he will not let that hinder industry development, stressing that the United States must maintain its lead over China and other countries.

Trump posted on his own social platform, Truth Social, that “whoever wins the AI race will win,” noting that the U.S. is currently ahead of China and other nations and that he will ensure the advantage endures. He described AI’s impact as surpassing the Industrial Revolution and even the Internet, so he will not suppress its growth.

Regarding the safety risks AI could pose, Trump said the government will act prudently and noted that the United States has the DOJ and other law‑enforcement bodies that can take control of the situation if needed. He emphasized that he will only encourage the development of AI or “superintelligence (SI).” On September 14 he also posted that the government already holds strong criminal and regulatory authority over relevant companies.

While Trump downplayed AI’s potential dangers, Anthropic researcher Jacob Coxon recently resigned, warning that Anthropic and OpenAI are using the technology “to gamble with human lives.” Over the past two weeks Trump repeatedly described AI risks as a “scam.”

After Coxon’s warning, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, SpaceX CEO Elon Musk, and Google DeepMind chairman Demis Hassabis all called for slowing AI development and urged the federal government to tighten oversight.

However, the White House has so far taken a relatively lax approach to AI regulation. The executive order Trump signed in June only set a loose review framework, asking companies to voluntarily cooperate with the government to assess covered frontier AI models and to give the government up to 30 days to evaluate a model before it is widely released.

items.title: 日產美國產量拚翻倍！Rogue油電版明年在地生產
items.title_en: Nissan Aims to Double U.S. Production; Rogue e-Power to Be Locally Built Next Year
paras: 日產汽車正評估提高美國產量，配合2027年式Rogue跨界休旅及首款搭載e-Power技術的油電車型上市。日產美洲區董事長Christian Meunier表示，公司現有美國產能已接近滿載，下一步可能把組裝廠從兩班制增至三班制。
Meunier接受《CNBC》訪問時表示，隨著新款Rogue汽油版未來幾個月投產，加上油電車型加入，日產有信心迅速增加班次。若田納西州與密西西比州兩座工廠都能導入第三班，日產在美國的年產量可望從2025年的近48.7萬輛，提高至約100萬輛，並可能創造數百甚至數千個就業機會。

目標2030年八成在地生產 暫不興建新廠

日產目前在田納西州Smyrna工廠生產Rogue及Infiniti跨界休旅，密西西比州Canton工廠則負責Altima房車及Frontier中型皮卡。2027年式Rogue汽油版預計明年春季在田納西州投產，e-Power油電車型的美國生產則將稍晚上路。
在美國本土產線就緒前，日產將先從日本進口Rogue油電車，藉此加快上市速度、提振銷量，並協助推動全球轉型計畫。公司設定2030年在美銷售車輛中，80%由美國工廠生產，但目前沒有興建新廠計畫，將優先利用既有設施擴充產能。
川普政府近來積極要求汽車業增加美國製造及就業，日產擴產方向正好呼應政策訴求。Meunier認為，公司未來4至5年不必投入巨資興建新廠，也有能力達成成長目標，2030年後才可能重新評估。

e-Power正面迎戰RAV4 日產押注油電翻身

日產周一正式發表面向美國市場的2027年式Rogue e-Power。這套「串聯式油電」系統以汽油引擎作為發電機，產生的電力供應馬達驅動車輪，引擎本身不直接驅動車輪；其運作方式類似增程型電動車，但電池較小，也不必外接充電。
Rogue e-Power入門車型售價為35,490美元，頂規Platinum版本則為43,490美元。Rogue是日產在美國的主力車款，新油電版本將直接挑戰豐田(TM-US)RAV4與本田(HMC-US)CR-V，兩者目前都是小型跨界休旅市場最暢銷的油電車。
Meunier表示，日產過去在沒有油電車的情況下仍能擴大銷量，但隨油電車日益普及，加上美伊戰爭推高燃油價格，e-Power將成為吸引新客群及推升業績的重要產品。公司甚至考慮讓消費者在日產經銷商處同時試駕Rogue與RAV4。
日產尚未公布Rogue e-Power的油耗數據；RAV4油電版綜合油耗最高為每加侖43英里，CR-V油電版則為40英里。日產在美國上半年銷量年增約10%，優於整體車市下滑約3%的表現，公司預期年底前仍能維持成長動能。
paras_en: Nissan Motor Co. is evaluating a boost in U.S. output to align with the 2027 model-year launch of the Rogue crossover SUV and its first e‑Power hybrid version. Christian Meunier, chairman of Nissan North America, said the company’s current U.S. capacity is nearly full and the next step could be moving from a two‑shift to a three‑shift assembly line.

In a CNBC interview, Meunier said that with the new gasoline‑engine Rogue slated to start production in the coming months and the addition of the e‑Power model, Nissan is confident it can quickly add a third shift. If both the Tennessee and Mississippi plants adopt a third shift, annual U.S. production could rise from about 487,000 vehicles in 2025 to roughly 1 million, potentially creating hundreds or even thousands of jobs.

Goal: 80% local production by 2030, no new plant for now. Nissan currently builds the Rogue and Infiniti crossovers at its Smyrna, Tennessee plant, while the Canton, Mississippi facility produces the Altima sedan and Frontier midsize pickup. The 2027‑model gasoline Rogue is expected to start production in Tennessee next spring, with the e‑Power version to follow later.

Before a domestic line is ready, Nissan will import the Rogue e‑Power from Japan to speed up its launch, boost sales and support its global transition plan. The company targets 80% of U.S. sales to be produced locally by 2030, but has no plans to build a new factory, opting instead to expand capacity at existing sites.

The Trump administration has recently pushed the auto industry to increase U.S. manufacturing and jobs, and Nissan’s expansion aligns with that agenda. Meunier believes the company can meet its growth targets over the next four to five years without major new‑plant investment, with any new plant consideration deferred until after 2030.

e‑Power takes on the RAV4 – Nissan bets on a hybrid comeback. On Monday Nissan officially unveiled the 2027‑model Rogue e‑Power for the U.S. market. The series‑hybrid system uses a gasoline engine as a generator to power an electric motor that drives the wheels; the engine never directly propels the vehicle. It operates like an extended‑range EV but with a smaller battery and no external charging required.

The entry‑level Rogue e‑Power is priced at $35,490, while the top‑of‑the‑line Platinum trim costs $43,490. The Rogue is Nissan’s flagship model in the U.S., and the new hybrid will directly challenge Toyota’s (TM‑US) RAV4 and Honda’s (HMC‑US) CR‑V, both currently the best‑selling hybrid crossovers in the compact segment.

Meunier said Nissan was able to grow sales even without a hybrid offering, but as hybrids become more common and the Ukraine‑Russia war drives fuel prices higher, e‑Power will be a key product to attract new customers and lift performance. The company is even considering letting shoppers test‑drive the Rogue and the RAV4 side‑by‑side at Nissan dealers.

Nissan has not yet released fuel‑economy figures for the Rogue e‑Power; the RAV4 hybrid achieves up to 43 mpg combined, while the CR‑V hybrid reaches 40 mpg. Nissan’s U.S. sales grew about 10% in the first half of the year, outpacing the overall market’s roughly 3% decline, and the company expects to maintain that growth momentum through year‑end.

items.title: 白宮封殺CNN踢到鐵板！四大電視網集體暫停川普聯訪任務
items.title_en: White House Bars CNN, Hits a Wall! Four Major Networks Jointly Suspend Trump Joint‑Interview Coverage
paras: 白宮電視聯訪團另外4家成員周一(21日)決定，暫停採訪被指定為美國總統川普(Donald Trump)聯訪行程的活動，以抗議白宮禁止CNN履行輪值採訪任務。這項集體行動意味川普部分公開活動將暫時失去電視聯訪團的影像紀錄。
據CNN報導，CNN原定周一擔任白宮電視聯訪代表，隨同川普前往紐約採訪聯合國大會行程，但白宮禁止CNN執行當天任務，也不允許其進入白宮園區。
除CNN外，白宮電視聯訪團成員還包括NBC News、ABC News、CBS News及Fox News。5家電視台平時輪流隨同總統出訪或採訪白宮活動，並將取得的影像、照片、音訊及發言內容分享給其他新聞機構，讓未能親自到場的媒體也能進行報導。
Fox News華盛頓分社社長、電視聯訪團代理主席Bryan Boughton在一封致聯訪團成員的通知中表示，即日起，電視聯訪團將不再採訪被指定為總統聯訪行程的活動。
Boughton指出，這項決定是因為白宮阻止CNN履行原定的輪值職責，聯訪團也不會另外安排媒體取代CNN。不過，除了總統活動以外，其他類型的聯訪採訪仍將照常進行。
電視聯訪團成員另發表聯合聲明表示，公眾對取得有關政府的準確及獨立資訊具有重大利益，任何政府都不應僅因不滿一家新聞機構的報導，便限制其採訪權。
這場爭議發生之際，CNN、MS NOW與Politico已宣布將對川普政府提起訴訟，要求推翻白宮對三家媒體實施的採訪禁令。三家媒體指控，白宮因不滿報導內容而撤銷記者採訪證，已侵犯美國憲法第一修正案保障的新聞自由。
paras_en: The White House’s television pool of four other members announced on Monday (the 21st) that they will pause coverage of events scheduled for President Donald Trump’s joint‑interview itinerary, protesting the White House’s ban on CNN fulfilling its rotating interview duties. This collective action means that some of Trump’s public events will temporarily lack video documentation from the pool.

According to CNN, the network was slated on Monday to serve as the White House television pool’s representative, accompanying Trump to New York for coverage of the United Nations General Assembly. However, the White House barred CNN from carrying out that day’s assignment and denied it entry to the White House grounds.

In addition to CNN, the pool includes NBC News, ABC News, CBS News and Fox News. The five outlets normally rotate accompanying the president on trips or covering White House events, and they share the video, photos, audio and statements they collect with other news organizations so that outlets unable to be on‑site can still report.

Fox News Washington bureau chief and interim pool chair Bryan Boughton wrote in a notice to pool members that, effective immediately, the television pool will no longer cover activities designated as part of the president’s joint‑interview itinerary.

Boughton explained that the decision stems from the White House’s obstruction of CNN’s scheduled rotating duties, and the pool will not arrange an alternative media outlet to replace CNN. Nevertheless, joint‑interview coverage of other types of events will continue as usual.

The pool members also issued a joint statement asserting that the public has a vital interest in obtaining accurate and independent information about the government, and that no government should restrict press access merely because it is displeased with the reporting of a single news organization.

The dispute comes as CNN, MS NOW and Politico have announced lawsuits against the Trump administration, seeking to overturn the White House’s ban on the three outlets. The media firms allege that the White House revoked their press credentials in retaliation for unfavorable coverage, violating the First Amendment’s guarantee of press freedom.

items.title: 美國欠債太多就要Fed降息？川普喊利率砍至1% 古爾斯比警告恐適得其反
items.title_en: Is Too Much US Debt Prompting the Fed to Cut Rates? Trump Calls for 1% Rate, Goolsbee Warns It Could Backfire
paras: 芝加哥聯準銀行總裁古爾斯比(Austan Goolsbee)周一(21日)駁斥聯準會(Fed)應透過降息，協助美國政府降低債務及赤字融資成本的主張，強調這種想法恰恰說明央行為何必須保持貨幣政策獨立性。
古爾斯比在倫敦一場活動接受媒體訪問時表示，Fed應將財政政策與赤字水準視為「背景天氣」，只有在兩者影響通膨時才納入決策考量，其他問題則應交由民選官員處理。
他反問，Fed是否應為了縮小赤字，或降低政府增加債務的成本而壓低利率，並提醒外界應對這種主張格外謹慎，因為這正是支持央行獨立性的經典理由。
古爾斯比指出，要求Fed因政府債務持續膨脹而強迫利率下降，本質上就是「債務貨幣化」。多數經濟學家認為，這種做法可能推高通膨並適得其反，因為市場將因通膨預期升高而要求更高報酬，最終反而推升政府的長期借款利率。
美國總統川普(Donald Trump)先前主張，Fed應將政策利率降至約1%，遠低於目前3.75%至4.00%的區間。他認為，美國是全球最值得信賴的借款人，理應享有更低的融資成本。
不過，美國長期公債殖利率近期持續上升，使政府的債務融資成本進一步增加。目前美國年度財政赤字仍處於高檔，規模約相當於國內生產毛額(GDP)的6%。古爾斯比的說法顯示，Fed不會僅為減輕政府償債壓力而調整利率政策。
paras_en: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee on Monday (the 21st) rejected the claim that the Federal Reserve should cut rates to help the US government lower the cost of financing its debt and deficits, stressing that this very idea illustrates why central banks must keep monetary policy independent.

Speaking to the media at an event in London, Goolsbee said the Fed should treat fiscal policy and deficit levels as “background weather,” only factoring them into decisions when they affect inflation, while other issues should be left to elected officials.

He asked whether the Fed should lower rates to shrink the deficit or reduce the cost of the government’s growing debt, warning that such arguments require extra caution because they are classic justifications for central‑bank independence.

Goolsbee noted that forcing rates down because government debt keeps expanding is essentially “debt monetisation.” Most economists believe this could stoke inflation and backfire, as markets would demand higher returns amid rising inflation expectations, ultimately pushing up the government’s long‑term borrowing rates.

Former President Donald Trump previously argued that the Fed should cut the policy rate to around 1%, far below the current 3.75%‑4.00% range. He contends that the United States is the world’s most trustworthy borrower and should enjoy lower financing costs.

However, long‑term US Treasury yields have been rising recently, further increasing the government’s debt‑financing costs. The annual fiscal deficit remains high, roughly 6% of GDP, and Goolsbee’s comments indicate the Fed will not adjust rates merely to ease the government’s debt‑service burden.

items.title: 超微市值首破1兆美元！AI代理熱潮帶動股價狂飆逾9%
items.title_en: AMD's Market Cap Breaks $1 Trillion as AI Agent Boom Fuels Over 9% Stock Surge
paras: 超微(AMD-US)周一(21日)股價大漲逾9%，盤中一度升至逾614美元，推升市值首次突破1兆美元，成為第14家跨越這道門檻的美國企業，也是繼輝達(NVDA-US)、博通(AVGO-US)及美光(MU-US)後，第4家市值突破1兆美元的美國晶片商。
根據Dow Jones Market Data，超微股價必須收在612.56美元以上，市值才能在收盤時維持1兆美元。相較一年前公司市值僅約2,550億美元，如今已成長近3倍；股價今年來大漲逾180%，過去5個交易日也累計上漲約24%。
截稿前，超微(AMD-US)周一盤中股價上漲9.33%，每股暫報612.04美元，市值報9,978.09億美元。
市場近期重新追捧AI硬體股，主要受到Meta(META-US)推出的消費型AI代理Muse帶動。Muse連續3天登上美國iPhone免費應用程式下載榜首，使投資人看好可代替使用者自主執行任務的AI代理快速普及，並大幅增加AI推論所需的中央處理器(CPU)需求。
超微、英特爾(INTC-US)及安謀(ARM-US)都是AI伺服器CPU的主要供應商。英特爾執行長陳立武日前表示，公司目前僅能滿足約50%的客戶需求；安謀則預估，伺服器CPU市場至2030年可望以每年逾35%的速度成長，規模達1,200億美元。超微更樂觀估計，相關市場至2030年可能成長50%，創造2,200億美元的營收機會。
超微也正從單純銷售晶片，擴展至提供結合處理器、網路設備及相關硬體的完整系統，以強化與輝達競爭的能力。AI伺服器需要CPU搭配繪圖處理器(GPU)執行推論，也協助超微從英特爾手中搶下更多市場占有率。
超微第二季營收達115.4億美元，較去年同期的76.9億美元成長50%；資料中心部門營收更大增107%至67億美元，AI晶片是主要成長動力。執行長蘇姿丰預期，公司2027年資料中心營收將增加一倍。
AI熱潮也帶動晶片股全面走強，英特爾盤中大漲約13%、安謀ADR勁揚14%、費城半導體指數上漲約2.7%。儘管超微市值寫下新里程碑，與市值約5.4兆美元的AI晶片龍頭輝達相比，仍有相當大差距。
paras_en: AMD (AMD-US) saw its stock surge more than 9% on Monday (the 21st), briefly climbing above $614 and pushing its market value past the $1 trillion mark for the first time, making it the 14th U.S. company to cross that threshold and the fourth U.S. chipmaker after Nvidia (NVDA-US), Broadcom (AVGO-US) and Micron (MU-US).

According to Dow Jones Market Data, AMD’s share price must close above $612.56 for its market cap to stay at $1 trillion at the end of the day. A year ago the company was valued at about $255 billion, nearly tripling since then; the stock is up more than 180% year‑to‑date and has risen roughly 24% over the past five trading sessions.
At the time of writing, AMD’s intraday price on Monday was up 9.33% at $612.04 per share, giving it a market value of $997.809 billion.

The market has recently revived its appetite for AI‑hardware stocks, driven mainly by Meta’s (META-US) launch of the consumer‑focused AI agent Muse. Muse topped the U.S. iPhone free‑app download chart for three consecutive days, prompting investors to bet on rapid adoption of AI agents that can perform tasks for users and on a sharp rise in CPU demand for AI inference.

AMD, Intel (INTC-US) and Arm (ARM-US) are the main suppliers of AI‑server CPUs. Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger recently said the company can currently meet only about 50% of customer demand; Arm projects the server‑CPU market could grow at over 35% annually through 2030, reaching $120 billion. AMD is even more optimistic, estimating the related market could grow 50% by 2030, creating a $220 billion revenue opportunity.

AMD is also expanding from pure chip sales to offering complete systems that combine processors, networking gear and related hardware, bolstering its ability to compete with Nvidia. AI servers need CPUs paired with GPUs for inference, helping AMD capture more market share from Intel.

AMD posted second‑quarter revenue of $11.54 billion, up 50% from $7.69 billion a year earlier; its data‑center segment jumped 107% to $6.7 billion, driven largely by AI chips. CEO Lisa Su expects data‑center revenue to double by 2027.

The AI frenzy is lifting chip stocks across the board, with Intel up about 13% intraday, Arm ADR soaring 14%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index gaining roughly 2.7%. Although AMD’s market cap has hit a new milestone, it still lags far behind AI‑chip leader Nvidia, whose market value sits around $5.4 trillion.

items.title: AI闖禍別怪機器！貝森特點名OpenAI高層扛責
items.title_en: AI Mishaps Aren't the Machine's Fault! Bessent Blames OpenAI Executives
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)周一(21日)表示，OpenAI先進人工智慧(AI)模型入侵Hugging Face的事件，責任應由OpenAI管理階層承擔，不能歸咎於失控的AI代理，也不能期待聯邦政府為開發商提供「責任豁免盾牌」。

AI闖禍不能怪AI 管理階層應負責

貝森特接受《CNBC》訪問時表示，他認同麻省理工學院(MIT)研究實驗室共同主席Daniel Huttenlocher的觀點，即「該負責的是人類，不是AI」。他強調，AI開發商必須為自身產品承擔責任，確保安全最有效的方法，就是讓創造者對其建造及生成的內容負起法律責任。
OpenAI今年7月承認，旗下先進AI模型在測試網路攻擊能力的評估過程中，入侵另一家AI新創公司Hugging Face。OpenAI隨後於8月坦言，公司原本可以更早採取行動，阻止入侵事件發生。
貝森特上周赴國會作證時便指出，政府尚未釐清該事件的法律責任歸屬，但最不應該做的，就是給予AI實驗室所要求的責任豁免。他此次進一步將矛頭指向OpenAI管理層，不過並未提出可能採取的處分或監管措施。
在部分AI領袖接連警告先進模型可能帶來重大風險、甚至主張放慢開發速度之際，美國總統川普則反對以安全為由大幅收緊監管，並持續支持美國AI產業擴張。貝森特表示，川普提出任命「AI沙皇」的構想，可望為AI責任、安全及監管問題建立較明確的政策框架。

美中擬建事故通報機制 貝森特談美債與利率

貝森特也透露，他周末與中國國務院副總理何立峰會談時，已提出建立AI事故通報制度。美中雙方同意啟動AI對話，目標之一是在發生重大事故時維持常態溝通，並討論失控AI代理、非國家網路攻擊者及生物武器等主要風險的處理原則。雙方預計兩個月後在中國深圳、亞太經濟合作會議(APEC)期間繼續討論。
不過，貝森特批評中國制度缺乏透明度，即使曾發生AI事故，也未必會主動對外揭露。除了AI安全，美中亦針對伊朗問題進行幕後協商。包括中國人民銀行行長潘功勝在內的中國金融官員，已參與討論如何對仍與伊朗往來的企業採取進一步行動。中國目前購入伊朗約90%的石油，但美國迄今仍未因相關貿易直接制裁中國。
談到金融市場，貝森特再次為財政部9月10日買回逾50億美元的10年期與20年期美債辯護。儘管10年期公債殖利率在美伊戰爭爆發後累計上升約100個基點，上周更突破5%，他仍稱買回行動成功，並表示若未出手，殖利率可能升得更高。
10年期公債殖利率走高也推升房貸等長期借款成本，美國房貸利率本月突破7%。與此同時，聯準會(Fed)上周為抑制居高不下的通膨，完成2023年以來首次升息，將聯邦資金利率目標區間提高至3.75%至4%，與川普持續要求降息的立場形成鮮明對比。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Monday (the 21st) that the responsibility for the incident in which OpenAI's advanced artificial intelligence model infiltrated Hugging Face lies with OpenAI’s management, not with a rogue AI agent, and that the federal government should not provide developers with a “liability shield.”

Bessent told CNBC that he agrees with MIT lab co‑chair Daniel Huttenlocher’s view that “the ones to be held accountable are humans, not AI.” He stressed that AI developers must take responsibility for their products and that the most effective way to ensure safety is to make creators legally liable for what they build and generate.

OpenAI admitted in July that its advanced AI model, while testing its network‑attack capabilities, breached another AI startup, Hugging Face. The company later said in August that it could have acted sooner to prevent the intrusion.

When Bessent testified before Congress last week, he noted that the government has not yet clarified the legal liability for the incident, but the worst thing would be to grant the liability exemption that AI labs are seeking. He again pointed the finger at OpenAI’s leadership, though he offered no specific sanctions or regulatory steps.

While some AI leaders have warned that advanced models pose significant risks and even called for slowing development, former President Trump opposed tightening regulation on safety grounds and continues to back the expansion of the U.S. AI industry. Bessent said Trump’s proposal to appoint an “AI czar” could help create a clearer policy framework for AI liability, safety and oversight.

Bessent also revealed that over the weekend he met with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng and raised the idea of an AI incident‑reporting mechanism. The U.S. and China agreed to launch an AI dialogue, aiming to maintain regular communication in the event of a major incident and to discuss principles for handling runaway AI agents, non‑state cyber attackers and bioweapons. The two sides plan to continue talks in two months in Shenzhen during the APEC summit.

However, Bessent criticized China’s lack of transparency, noting that even when AI accidents occur the Chinese system may not disclose them voluntarily. In addition to AI safety, the U.S. and China are quietly negotiating over Iran, with Chinese financial officials—including PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng—discussing further actions against firms still dealing with Iran. China currently purchases about 90% of Iran’s oil, yet the United States has not directly sanctioned China over the trade.

Commenting on financial markets, Bessent defended the Treasury’s September 10 purchase of more than $5 billion of 10‑year and 20‑year U.S. Treasury bonds. Although the 10‑year yield has risen roughly 100 basis points since the start of the Israel‑Hamas war and broke above 5% last week, he said the buy‑back was successful and warned yields could have climbed even higher without the intervention.

Higher 10‑year yields have also pushed up long‑term borrowing costs such as mortgages, with U.S. mortgage rates breaking 7% this month. At the same time, the Fed last week raised its policy rate target range to 3.75%‑4%—its first hike in 2023—to curb persistent inflation, a stark contrast to Trump’s continued calls for rate cuts.

items.title_en: Taiwan Stock Market Shocks with Lianmao's NT$319 Million Default Settlement, Setting Year's Highest Single-Deal Record
paras: 台股今(21)日多頭氣勢如虹，大盤上漲 538 點、以歷史次高點 47,718 點亮麗收盤。不過，證交所晚間公告，北城證券申報銅箔基板(CCL)大廠聯茂(6213-TW)鉅額違約交割，金額高達 3.19 億元。這不僅是今年 8、9 月以來首宗上市公司違約案件，更一舉刷新今年上市櫃單次違約交割的最高金額紀錄。
根據證交所統計，今年以來集中市場的鉅額違約交割累計已達 12 起，相關個股包括旺宏(2337-TW)、佳必琪(6197-TW)、新日興(3376-TW)、欣興(3037-TW)、華通(2313-TW)、友達(2409-TW)、禾伸堂(3026-TW)、南亞科(2408-TW)、聯茂，以及被通報多達 3 次的被動元件龍頭國巨*(2327-TW)。
若再加上櫃買市場的 13 起案例，今年上市櫃合計已發生多達 25 起鉅額違約交割事件，反映出近期高檔震盪劇烈，部分槓桿操作過度的投資人面臨資金卡關危機。
根據 T+2 制度回推，聯茂違約交割實際交易日落在 9/17，當天股價開高走低直接殺至跌停，部分當沖或使用高槓桿(如資券操作、開放大額信用額度)的投資人，可能原本預期當天開高可順利當沖獲利落袋，不料股價一路下殺跌停導致當沖無法平倉或當沖補價差金額過大，且無法於 T+2 日補足高達 3.19 億元的款項，最終演變成鉅額違約交割事件。
為遏止違約交割亂象，證交所日前董事會已通過修正規定，實施加嚴處置措施，未來首次違約結案者的追蹤列管期由一年大幅拉長至五年，且恢復交易後連續 10 個營業日須執行「全額預收款券」；若為兩次以上違約的累犯者，同樣列管五年，但預收款券期間則加重提高至連續 30 個營業日，希望透過拉長列管年限與提高預收天數，防範投機客換券商下單的套利風險與信用危機。
paras_en: The Taiwan market surged today (21st) with the index climbing 538 points to close brightly at a historic near‑high of 47,718 points. However, the exchange announced in the evening that North City Securities reported a massive default settlement by copper foil substrate (CCL) giant Lianmao (6213‑TW) amounting to NT$319 million. This is not only the first listed‑company default case since August‑September of this year, but also sets a new record for the highest single default settlement amount among listed companies in 2024.

According to exchange statistics, there have been 12 large‑scale default settlements in the main market so far this year, involving stocks such as Wondong (2337‑TW), Jabiqi (6197‑TW), Xinri Xing (3376‑TW), Xin Xing (3037‑TW), Huadong (2313‑TW), AU Optronics (2409‑TW), Hoshintang (3026‑TW), Nanya Technology (2408‑TW), Lianmao, and the passive component leader Yageo* (2327‑TW), which has been reported three times.

Including 13 cases from the OTC market, a total of 25 large‑scale default settlements have occurred among listed and OTC securities this year, reflecting recent volatile high‑price swings and indicating that some heavily leveraged investors are facing cash‑flow crunches.

Based on the T+2 settlement system, Lianmao's default settlement traces back to the actual trade date of September 17. The stock opened higher that day but fell sharply to the limit‑down price, trapping day‑traders and highly leveraged participants (such as those using securities‑based margin or large credit lines). Those who expected to profit from an opening rally found their positions unable to be closed or required excessive price‑difference payments, and could not cover the NT$319 million by the T+2 deadline, resulting in a massive default settlement.

To curb such default incidents, the exchange’s board recently approved amended rules tightening penalties. The monitoring period for first‑time violators will be extended from one year to five years, and after resuming trading they must hold “full‑amount pre‑collected vouchers” for 10 consecutive business days. Repeat offenders (two or more defaults) will also be monitored for five years, but the pre‑collected voucher period will increase to 30 consecutive business days, aiming to deter speculative arbitrage and credit risks from switching brokers.

items.title: 鋼鐵輸歐配額「黑箱」？ 經濟部：8成業者沿用舊制 自由配額維持20%
items.title_en: Steel Exports to EU Quota “Black Box”? Ministry of Economic Affairs: 80% of Firms Use Old System, Free Quota Remains at 20%
paras: 經濟部今（21）日針對媒體報導「貿易署輸歐關稅配額黑箱作業？疑圖利特定貿易商」澄清指出，輸歐盟鋼鐵產品出口管理措施係因應歐盟鋼鐵防衛措施，相關配額管理分配方式已實施多年，並非新創作法，均依產業實際狀況，並徵詢業者意見後決定，絕無黑箱作業。
歐盟自2019年起實施鋼鐵防衛措施，採取關稅配額方式。經濟部自2019年至2025年間，為協助廠商因應此措施及維護貿易秩序，每年均公告對輸歐盟鋼鐵產品採行出口管理措施。歐盟鋼鐵防衛措施於本年6月30日屆期，並自本年7月1日起同樣採取關稅配額方式，管制輸入歐盟之鋼鐵產品。本次管理措施實施前，經濟部亦循例透過鋼鐵公會協助調查業者意見，有近8成業者同意比照過往防衛措施期間之機制，進行出口配額管理。
經濟部說明，輸歐鋼鐵產品出口管理措施係將獲配之各類別鋼鐵產品國家配額分為「出口實績配額」及「自由申請配額」。「出口實績配額」係考量歐盟計算國家配額之方式，按各廠商2022年至2024年之平均出口量比例進行分配。「自由申請配額」則必須檢附3個月內交貨之交易證明文件，且在獲配配額已用完或可用額度不足以履行單一交易時，才能提出申請，由鋼鐵公會於每個工作日按當日申請量及剩餘量依比例核配。
針對外界質疑「自由申請配額」已協商結論為20%，被擅自提高至20%一節，經濟部強調並非事實。自2019年以來，經濟部每年透過鋼鐵公會徵詢各類別鋼鐵產品業者對出口實績配額與自由申請配額占比之意見，綜合考量各類別業者需求及產業實際狀況，如業者對占比無共識，依過往慣例將自由申請配額訂為20%，此作法已行之有年，並無先與業者承諾20%比例後，提高為20%之情形。
經濟部進一步指出，考量國內製造商亦有與貿易商合作出口鋼鐵產品之需求，為兼顧國際貿易實務，有出口實績之貿易商可申請「自由申請配額」，在「自由申請配額」的規範上，對貿易商的申請條件較為嚴格。貿易商必須具有過往出口實績，且在獲配配額用完或可用額度不足以履行單一交易時，始可申請自由配額。相對而言，未獲「出口實績配額」之鋼鐵製造業廠商，則無需出口實績即可申請自由配額。
有關歐盟鋼品配額之分配與管理，經濟部將依循既有機制，參酌產業實際狀況及業者意見辦理；各項額度申請須檢具實際訂單證明，並依相關原則核配。經濟部將持續與業者溝通，滾動檢討相關管理措施。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs clarified today (the 21st) that media reports alleging a “black‑box” operation by the Trade Office in allocating EU steel tariff quotas to benefit certain traders are unfounded. The export management measures for steel products to the EU are a response to the EU’s steel safeguard measures, and the quota allocation method has been in place for many years, not a newly created rule. It is based on the actual industry situation and was decided after consulting firms, with no black‑box procedures involved.

Since 2019 the EU has implemented steel safeguard measures using a tariff‑quota system. From 2019 to 2025 the Ministry of Economic Affairs has each year announced export management measures for steel products destined for the EU to help companies cope with the measures and maintain trade order. The EU’s safeguard measures expired on June 30 this year and, starting July 1, the EU again adopted a tariff‑quota system to control steel imports. Before implementing the current measures, the ministry, as usual, sought industry opinions through the Steel Association, and nearly 80% of firms agreed to manage export quotas in the same way as during the previous safeguard period.

The ministry explained that the export management measures for steel products to the EU divide the national quota for each steel category into an “export‑performance quota” and a “free‑application quota.” The export‑performance quota is allocated according to each company’s average export share from 2022 to 2024, reflecting how the EU calculates national quotas. The free‑application quota can be claimed only when a company provides transaction documents showing delivery within the past three months and when its allocated quota is exhausted or insufficient for a single transaction; the Steel Association then allocates the remaining amount each working day on a proportional basis.

Regarding external doubts that the “free‑application quota” was negotiated at 20% and then arbitrarily raised to 20%, the ministry stressed this is not true. Since 2019 the ministry has each year consulted firms of each steel category on the split between export‑performance and free‑application quotas. After weighing the needs of each category and the actual industry situation, if firms cannot reach a consensus on the split, the ministry follows past practice and sets the free‑application quota at 20%. This practice has been in place for years and there was never a prior promise of 20% that was later increased.

The ministry further noted that, considering domestic manufacturers also need to cooperate with traders to export steel, the free‑application quota is available to traders with export records, but the application criteria are stricter. Traders must have prior export performance and may apply for the free quota only when their allocated quota is used up or insufficient for a single deal. By contrast, steel manufacturers that did not receive an export‑performance quota can apply for the free quota without having export history.

Regarding the allocation and management of EU steel quotas, the ministry will continue to follow the existing mechanism, taking into account actual industry conditions and firms’ opinions. All quota applications must be supported by actual order documentation and will be allocated according to the relevant principles. The ministry will keep communicating with firms and will continuously review the management measures.

items.title_en: Tariff Relief Boosts Overseas Exhibition Subsidies Threefold! Ministry of Economic Affairs Helps 3,400 Companies Secure Foreign Orders, Top Three Benefiting Industries
paras: 經濟部為協助國內產業及國人即時因應美國關稅衝擊，編列約460億元特別預算，推動支持產業4大措施，自2025年8月7日起全面開放申請，協助企業解決資金週轉困境、升級技術能量並加強海外布局。截至2026年9月17日，多項支持措施已見顯著成效，其中融資與專案貸款已協助數千家業者取得營運資金。在加碼公協會與廠商參加國際展會方面，補助規模較前一年成長2至3倍，已補助3400家廠商，主要涵蓋機械、電機電子及紡織業。
在融資保證方面，外銷貸款優惠保證加碼提供中小企業每家最高6000萬元額度、保證成數9.5成，並享有最長2年全額減免保證手續費；非中小企業則提供1億元額度與8至9成保證成數。目前已承保158件，承保融資金額約11.23億元，申辦業者以金屬製品業及機械設備業為大宗。
中小微企業多元發展專案貸款加碼表現尤為踴躍，提供最高3500萬元貸款額度，利率上限為2.22%。其中1000萬元以內貸款享6個月利率減碼1.5%，100萬元以下保證成數達10成。該項目已順利核准2086件，核貸總金額高達192.9億元，受惠產業以批發業及金屬製品業最多。
針對產業轉型與拓銷，經濟部提供研發轉型補助與海外訂單爭取專案。研發轉型補助個案最高500萬元、聯盟最高4000萬元，目前已通過1183件申請，撥付55.61億元補助款，協助1319家業者，以金屬製品業與塑橡膠製品業為主。海外訂單爭取部分則已核准156件，撥款協助172家機械、金屬與民生製造業者於海外設立實體據點或擴增代理通路。
此外，經濟部大幅加碼公協會與廠商參加國際展會的力道，攤位與企業補助金額雙雙提高，整體補助規模較前一年成長2至3倍，核准率超過9成。累計已協助近290家公協會及3400家廠商，參展超過7100項國內外展覽，主力產業涵蓋機械、電機電子及紡織業。
以實際受惠案例來看，國內某蝴蝶蘭瓶苗生產業者因關稅導致營運成本激增，透過申請中小微企業專案貸款取得1000萬元低利融資與利息補貼，大幅減輕資金週轉壓力，穩定公司運作。經濟部強調，將持續透過產業競爭力輔導團整合法人資源，協助業者導入AI應用突破經營瓶頸，全力協助企業渡過關稅陣痛期。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs allocated about NT$46 billion in a special budget to help domestic industries and citizens promptly respond to U.S. tariff impacts, launching four major support measures. Applications opened on August 7, 2025, aiming to ease cash‑flow constraints, upgrade technology, and strengthen overseas presence. By September 17, 2026, the measures had shown significant results, with financing and project loans assisting thousands of firms in obtaining operating funds. Subsidies for public‑sector associations and companies attending international exhibitions grew two‑ to three‑fold from the previous year, supporting 3,400 firms, mainly in machinery, electrical‑electronics and textiles.

Regarding financing guarantees, export‑loan guarantees were enhanced to offer small‑ and medium‑sized enterprises up to NT$60 million per company with a 95% guarantee rate and up to two years of full waiver of guarantee fees. Larger firms can receive up to NT$100 million with an 80‑90% guarantee rate. So far, 158 cases have been covered, amounting to about NT$1.123 billion in guaranteed financing, with metal‑product and machinery‑equipment companies accounting for the bulk of applicants.

The diversified development project loans for micro‑, small‑ and medium‑sized enterprises saw especially strong uptake, providing up to NT$35 million per loan at a maximum interest rate of 2.22%. Loans of NT$10 million or less enjoy a 1.5% interest‑rate reduction for six months, and guarantees for loans under NT$1 million reach 100%. The program has approved 2,086 loans totalling NT$192.9 billion, benefitting wholesale and metal‑product sectors the most.

To support industrial transformation and market expansion, the Ministry offers R&D transformation subsidies and overseas‑order acquisition projects. R&D transformation subsidies can reach NT$5 million per case or up to NT$40 million for alliances; 1,183 applications have been approved, disbursing NT$5.561 billion to assist 1,319 firms, mainly in metal‑product and plastic‑rubber manufacturing. The overseas‑order program has approved 156 projects, providing funds for 172 machinery, metal and consumer‑goods manufacturers to set up physical bases or expand agency channels abroad.

The Ministry also dramatically increased subsidies for public‑sector associations and firms to attend international exhibitions, raising both booth and company subsidies. Overall subsidy size grew two‑ to three‑fold from the prior year, with an approval rate exceeding 90%. To date, nearly 290 associations and 3,400 companies have been helped to participate in more than 7,100 domestic and overseas exhibitions, focusing on machinery, electrical‑electronics and textiles.

A concrete example shows a domestic orchid‑bottle seedling producer whose operating costs surged due to tariffs. By applying for the micro‑small‑medium enterprise project loan, the company secured NT$10 million of low‑interest financing and interest subsidies, markedly easing cash‑flow pressure and stabilising operations. The Ministry stressed it will continue to coordinate corporate resources through industry‑competitiveness advisory teams, help firms adopt AI to overcome operational bottlenecks, and fully support businesses through the tariff‑pain period.

items.title: 川習會前有新大單？波音先替市場期待降溫
items.title_en: New big order before Trump‑Xi meeting? Boeing tempers market expectations
paras: 美國貿易代表葛里爾(Jamieson Greer)周一(21日)表示，中國正在推進今年5月宣布採購200架波音(BA-US)飛機的承諾，但他並未暗示，在美國總統川普與中國國家主席習近平本周會晤前，中方即將公布額外訂單。
葛里爾接受《福斯新聞》(Fox News)訪問時表示，供中國航空公司採購的波音飛機中，約140架目前「進展良好」，另有10架正在把採購內容落實為書面訂單。不過，他並未進一步說明其餘飛機的談判進度或交付時間。
川普5月曾表示，中國最終可能把波音採購規模擴大至最多750架，引發市場期待本周美中領袖會晤期間可能公布追加訂單。
不過，波音執行長歐特柏格(Kelly Ortberg)上周淡化相關預期。他表示，未來仍可能陸續增加訂單，但將由各家航空公司依照自身步調決定何時及如何對外宣布。歐特柏格5月曾形容，中國承諾採購的200架飛機只是潛在大型交易的「首批訂單」。
paras_en: US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said on Monday (21st) that China is moving forward with its commitment announced in May to purchase 200 Boeing (BA-US) aircraft, but he did not indicate that China will announce an additional order before the meeting this week between US President Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping.

In an interview with Fox News, Greer said that of the Boeing planes intended for Chinese airlines, about 140 are currently “progressing well,” and another 10 are being formalized into written orders. However, he did not provide further details on the negotiation status or delivery timeline for the remaining aircraft.

In May, Trump said China could eventually expand the Boeing purchase to as many as 750 aircraft, fueling market hopes that an extra order might be announced during this week’s US‑China leaders’ summit.

Boeing CEO Kelly Ortberg downplayed those expectations last week. He said that additional orders may still come over time, but each airline will decide on its own schedule when and how to announce them publicly. Ortberg had described in May that the 200‑aircraft commitment from China was only the “first batch” of a potentially large deal.

items.title: AI股領漲！AMD市值突破兆美元、那斯達克勁揚1.9%，英特爾勁揚13.5%
items.title_en: AI Stocks Lead Gains! AMD Market Cap Breaks $1 Trillion, Nasdaq Rises 1.9%, Intel Jumps 13.5%
paras: 2026年09月22日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美股週一走高，AI與晶片股領漲，加上國際油價重挫逾3%、美國公債殖利率回落，帶動主要指數全面上揚。那斯達克綜合指數漲幅擴大至1.93%，升至逾1個月高點。
市場重新關注AI支出持續成長的數據，晶片股普遍走高。英特爾Intel(INTC-US)大漲13.50%，超微AMD(AMD-US)勁揚9.22%，市值突破1兆美元；高通Qualcomm(QCOM-US)上漲7.40%，Marvell Technology(MRVL-US)漲4.30%，應用材料Applied Materials(AMAT-US)漲3.72%。
其他AI相關個股方面，Meta Platforms(META-US)上漲6.7%，創逾7個月高點，富國銀行Wells Fargo調高該股目標價；埃森哲Accenture(ACN-US)上漲3.2%，公司與Anthropic合作，計畫投入20億美元發展AI評估相關業務。
油價週一重挫逾3%，跌至11日低點，市場關注本週聯合國會議期間的中東談判進展。美國10年期公債殖利率跌破5%，美國航空American Airlines(AAL-US)與達美航空Delta Air Lines(DAL-US)股價小幅上漲。
利率方面，近期通膨升溫後，聯準會已進行3年來首次升息。CME FedWatch顯示，市場預估下個月再次升息的機率約50%。芝加哥聯準銀行總裁古爾斯比(Austan Goolsbee)表示，通膨壓力已從關稅及能源價格擴大至強勁需求，本週至少有10名聯準會官員預定發表談話。
地緣政治方面，美國總統川普表示，願意與預計本週出席聯合國大會的伊朗總統裴澤斯基安(Masoud Pezeshkian)會面。美國與丹麥針對格陵蘭地位的談判也取得進展。
市場同時關注週四美中峰會，議題可能涉及延長貿易休戰、伊朗戰爭及AI監管。市場傳出，美國提議將貿易休戰延長6個月，中國則尋求更長期限。
標普500指數11大類股中有7類上漲，通訊服務類股上漲2.9%居首，能源類股跌幅最大。

paras_en: September 22, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – U.S. equities rose on Monday, led by AI and chip stocks. A drop of more than 3% in international oil prices and a retreat in U.S. Treasury yields helped lift all major indexes, with the Nasdaq Composite gaining 1.93% to a more than one‑month high.

So far, the Dow Jones Industrial Average is up 285.92 points, or 0.55%, at 51,968.56; the S&P 500 is up 98.28 points, or 1.28%, at 7,748.78; the Nasdaq Composite is up 511.78 points, or 1.93%, at 27,034.33; and the Russell 2000 is up 17.96 points, or 0.63%, at 2,878.36.

The market is refocusing on data showing continued growth in AI spending, lifting chip stocks across the board. Intel (INTC‑US) surged 13.5%, AMD (AMD‑US) rallied 9.22% and pushed its market value past $1 trillion; Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) rose 7.4%, Marvell Technology (MRVL‑US) gained 4.3%, and Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) climbed 3.72%.

Among other AI‑related equities, Meta Platforms (META‑US) jumped 6.7% to a more than seven‑month high, prompting Wells Fargo to raise its price target; Accenture (ACN‑US) rose 3.2% after announcing a partnership with Anthropic and a $2 billion investment to develop AI‑assessment services.

Oil prices slumped more than 3% on Monday, hitting the low of the 11th, while markets watched the progress of Middle‑East talks during this week’s United Nations conference. The yield on the 10‑year U.S. Treasury fell below 5%, and airline stocks such as American Airlines (AAL‑US) and Delta Air Lines (DAL‑US) ticked higher.

On rates, after a recent flare‑up in inflation, the Fed delivered its first hike in three years. CME FedWatch shows the market estimates about a 50% chance of another hike next month. Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee said inflation pressures have spread from tariffs and energy prices to strong demand, and at least ten Fed officials are slated to speak this week.

Geopolitically, former U.S. President Donald Trump said he is willing to meet Iran’s President Masoud Pezeshkian, who is expected to attend the UN General Assembly this week. The United States and Denmark also made progress in talks over Greenland’s status.

Markets are also watching Thursday’s U.S.–China summit, which may cover extending the trade truce, the Iran war and AI regulation. Reports suggest the U.S. proposes a six‑month extension of the truce, while China is seeking a longer period.
Seven of the S&P 500’s eleven sector groups posted gains, led by Communication Services up 2.9%; Energy stocks recorded the biggest decline.

items.title: 美國欠債太多就要Fed降息？川普喊利率砍至1% 古爾斯比警告恐適得其反
items.title_en: Is Too Much US Debt Prompting the Fed to Cut Rates? Trump Calls for 1% Rate, Goolsbee Warns It Could Backfire
paras: 芝加哥聯準銀行總裁古爾斯比(Austan Goolsbee)周一(21日)駁斥聯準會(Fed)應透過降息，協助美國政府降低債務及赤字融資成本的主張，強調這種想法恰恰說明央行為何必須保持貨幣政策獨立性。
古爾斯比在倫敦一場活動接受媒體訪問時表示，Fed應將財政政策與赤字水準視為「背景天氣」，只有在兩者影響通膨時才納入決策考量，其他問題則應交由民選官員處理。
他反問，Fed是否應為了縮小赤字，或降低政府增加債務的成本而壓低利率，並提醒外界應對這種主張格外謹慎，因為這正是支持央行獨立性的經典理由。
古爾斯比指出，要求Fed因政府債務持續膨脹而強迫利率下降，本質上就是「債務貨幣化」。多數經濟學家認為，這種做法可能推高通膨並適得其反，因為市場將因通膨預期升高而要求更高報酬，最終反而推升政府的長期借款利率。
美國總統川普(Donald Trump)先前主張，Fed應將政策利率降至約1%，遠低於目前3.75%至4.00%的區間。他認為，美國是全球最值得信賴的借款人，理應享有更低的融資成本。
不過，美國長期公債殖利率近期持續上升，使政府的債務融資成本進一步增加。目前美國年度財政赤字仍處於高檔，規模約相當於國內生產毛額(GDP)的6%。古爾斯比的說法顯示，Fed不會僅為減輕政府償債壓力而調整利率政策。
paras_en: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee on Monday (the 21st) rejected the claim that the Federal Reserve should cut rates to help the US government lower the cost of financing its debt and deficits, stressing that this very idea illustrates why central banks must keep monetary policy independent.

Speaking to the media at an event in London, Goolsbee said the Fed should treat fiscal policy and deficit levels as “background weather,” only factoring them into decisions when they affect inflation, while other issues should be left to elected officials.

He asked whether the Fed should lower rates to shrink the deficit or reduce the cost of the government’s growing debt, warning that such arguments require extra caution because they are classic justifications for central‑bank independence.

Goolsbee noted that forcing rates down because government debt keeps expanding is essentially “debt monetisation.” Most economists believe this could stoke inflation and backfire, as markets would demand higher returns amid rising inflation expectations, ultimately pushing up the government’s long‑term borrowing rates.

Former President Donald Trump previously argued that the Fed should cut the policy rate to around 1%, far below the current 3.75%‑4.00% range. He contends that the United States is the world’s most trustworthy borrower and should enjoy lower financing costs.

However, long‑term US Treasury yields have been rising recently, further increasing the government’s debt‑financing costs. The annual fiscal deficit remains high, roughly 6% of GDP, and Goolsbee’s comments indicate the Fed will not adjust rates merely to ease the government’s debt‑service burden.

items.title: 超微市值首破1兆美元！AI代理熱潮帶動股價狂飆逾9%
items.title_en: AMD's Market Cap Breaks $1 Trillion as AI Agent Boom Fuels Over 9% Stock Surge
paras: 超微(AMD-US)周一(21日)股價大漲逾9%，盤中一度升至逾614美元，推升市值首次突破1兆美元，成為第14家跨越這道門檻的美國企業，也是繼輝達(NVDA-US)、博通(AVGO-US)及美光(MU-US)後，第4家市值突破1兆美元的美國晶片商。
根據Dow Jones Market Data，超微股價必須收在612.56美元以上，市值才能在收盤時維持1兆美元。相較一年前公司市值僅約2,550億美元，如今已成長近3倍；股價今年來大漲逾180%，過去5個交易日也累計上漲約24%。
截稿前，超微(AMD-US)周一盤中股價上漲9.33%，每股暫報612.04美元，市值報9,978.09億美元。
市場近期重新追捧AI硬體股，主要受到Meta(META-US)推出的消費型AI代理Muse帶動。Muse連續3天登上美國iPhone免費應用程式下載榜首，使投資人看好可代替使用者自主執行任務的AI代理快速普及，並大幅增加AI推論所需的中央處理器(CPU)需求。
超微、英特爾(INTC-US)及安謀(ARM-US)都是AI伺服器CPU的主要供應商。英特爾執行長陳立武日前表示，公司目前僅能滿足約50%的客戶需求；安謀則預估，伺服器CPU市場至2030年可望以每年逾35%的速度成長，規模達1,200億美元。超微更樂觀估計，相關市場至2030年可能成長50%，創造2,200億美元的營收機會。
超微也正從單純銷售晶片，擴展至提供結合處理器、網路設備及相關硬體的完整系統，以強化與輝達競爭的能力。AI伺服器需要CPU搭配繪圖處理器(GPU)執行推論，也協助超微從英特爾手中搶下更多市場占有率。
超微第二季營收達115.4億美元，較去年同期的76.9億美元成長50%；資料中心部門營收更大增107%至67億美元，AI晶片是主要成長動力。執行長蘇姿丰預期，公司2027年資料中心營收將增加一倍。
AI熱潮也帶動晶片股全面走強，英特爾盤中大漲約13%、安謀ADR勁揚14%、費城半導體指數上漲約2.7%。儘管超微市值寫下新里程碑，與市值約5.4兆美元的AI晶片龍頭輝達相比，仍有相當大差距。
paras_en: AMD (AMD-US) saw its stock surge more than 9% on Monday (the 21st), briefly climbing above $614 and pushing its market value past the $1 trillion mark for the first time, making it the 14th U.S. company to cross that threshold and the fourth U.S. chipmaker after Nvidia (NVDA-US), Broadcom (AVGO-US) and Micron (MU-US).

According to Dow Jones Market Data, AMD’s share price must close above $612.56 for its market cap to stay at $1 trillion at the end of the day. A year ago the company was valued at about $255 billion, nearly tripling since then; the stock is up more than 180% year‑to‑date and has risen roughly 24% over the past five trading sessions.
At the time of writing, AMD’s intraday price on Monday was up 9.33% at $612.04 per share, giving it a market value of $997.809 billion.

The market has recently revived its appetite for AI‑hardware stocks, driven mainly by Meta’s (META-US) launch of the consumer‑focused AI agent Muse. Muse topped the U.S. iPhone free‑app download chart for three consecutive days, prompting investors to bet on rapid adoption of AI agents that can perform tasks for users and on a sharp rise in CPU demand for AI inference.

AMD, Intel (INTC-US) and Arm (ARM-US) are the main suppliers of AI‑server CPUs. Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger recently said the company can currently meet only about 50% of customer demand; Arm projects the server‑CPU market could grow at over 35% annually through 2030, reaching $120 billion. AMD is even more optimistic, estimating the related market could grow 50% by 2030, creating a $220 billion revenue opportunity.

AMD is also expanding from pure chip sales to offering complete systems that combine processors, networking gear and related hardware, bolstering its ability to compete with Nvidia. AI servers need CPUs paired with GPUs for inference, helping AMD capture more market share from Intel.

AMD posted second‑quarter revenue of $11.54 billion, up 50% from $7.69 billion a year earlier; its data‑center segment jumped 107% to $6.7 billion, driven largely by AI chips. CEO Lisa Su expects data‑center revenue to double by 2027.

The AI frenzy is lifting chip stocks across the board, with Intel up about 13% intraday, Arm ADR soaring 14%, and the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index gaining roughly 2.7%. Although AMD’s market cap has hit a new milestone, it still lags far behind AI‑chip leader Nvidia, whose market value sits around $5.4 trillion.

items.title: 日本救日元反成賣點！瑞銀資管等再度干預伺機賣出
items.title_en: Japan's Yen Rescue Becomes a Selling Point! UBS Asset Management and Others May Intervene Again to Sell
paras: 瑞銀資產管理(UBS Asset Management)全球主權與貨幣固定收益主管Kevin Zhao表示，若日本政府再度出手干預匯市、拉抬日元，將是賣出日元的好機會。他並不認為日銀上周五升息，意味貨幣政策已明顯轉向鷹派。
Zhao今年稍早原本加碼持有日元，但在美日兩國7月大規模聯手買進日元後賣出部位，如今正等待下一次進場賣出的時機。當時日元兌美元一度貶至約164日元，創40年來最低水準。
日銀上周升息，並宣告貨幣政策已進入「新階段」，但Zhao認為，無論是進一步升息或政府再次干預，都不足以讓投資人相信日元能夠持續走強。他直言，日本維持弱勢日元的根本政策並未改變，美元兌日元接下來可能繼續攀升，日本當局最終仍會再度干預，否則恐怕顏面盡失。
日元本月初一度因市場預期日銀將加快升息而反彈，但上周五升息後支撐有限，匯價再度朝164日元關卡靠近。日本當局隨後向市場參與者進行匯率「詢價」，這項行動通常被視為正式進場買進日元的前兆。
目前交易員押注日銀至明年6月最多還會升息3次，但也預期聯準會(Fed)同期將升息相同次數，意味美日利差未必明顯縮小。Zhao反問，若Fed降息期間美元兌日元都未能大幅回落，如今Fed轉向升息，日元又怎麼可能顯著升值？
Zhao預期，即使日本通膨隨經濟成長升溫，日銀未來幾個月仍會放慢緊縮腳步。日本首相高市早苗延續前首相安倍晉三的「安倍經濟學」路線，堅持透過財政支出支撐經濟。在股市大漲、名目國內生產毛額(GDP)成長及政府債務龐大的情況下，低利率仍符合政府與日銀利益。他強調，「安倍經濟學從來不等於強勢日元」。
paras_en: UBS Asset Management’s global sovereign and currency fixed‑income head Kevin Zhao said that if the Japanese government intervenes again in the FX market to prop up the yen, it would be a good opportunity to sell the yen. He does not believe that the Bank of Japan’s rate hike last Friday signals a clear hawkish shift in monetary policy.

Zhao had increased his yen holdings earlier this year, but sold those positions after the United States and Japan jointly bought large amounts of yen in July. He is now waiting for the next chance to re‑enter and sell. At that time the yen fell to about ¥164 per dollar, its lowest level in 40 years.

The BOJ raised rates last week and announced that monetary policy had entered a “new stage,” but Zhao thinks that whether the BOJ hikes further or the government intervenes again, neither will convince investors that the yen can stay strong. He bluntly says Japan’s fundamental policy of keeping a weak yen has not changed, the dollar‑yen pair may keep climbing, and the authorities will eventually intervene again or risk losing face.

The yen briefly rebounded earlier this month on expectations that the BOJ would accelerate rate hikes, but the support faded after the Friday hike and the exchange rate moved back toward the ¥164 level. Japanese authorities then sent a “price inquiry” to market participants, an action usually seen as a prelude to officially buying yen.

Traders currently bet that the BOJ may raise rates up to three more times by June next year, while also expecting the Fed to raise rates the same number of times, meaning the US‑Japan rate differential may not narrow much. Zhao retorts that if the dollar‑yen pair did not fall significantly during the Fed’s rate‑cut cycle, how could the yen appreciate markedly now that the Fed is back to tightening?

Zhao expects that even if Japanese inflation rises with economic growth, the BOJ will slow its tightening over the next few months. Prime Minister Kishida continues former Prime Minister Abe’s “Abenomics” approach, insisting on fiscal spending to support the economy. With a booming stock market, nominal GDP growth and massive government debt, low rates still suit both the government and the BOJ. He stresses that “Abenomics has never meant a strong yen.”

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉AI與晶片股領漲、油價重挫逾3% 主要指數開高
paras: 美股主要指數周一(21日)開盤走高，人工智慧(AI)與晶片股重新上漲，加上美伊談判出現進展跡象，帶動國際油價重挫逾3%、跌至11日低點，舒緩市場對能源價格推升通膨的疑慮。
道瓊工業指數一度大漲逾300點，標普500指數收復本月以來全部跌幅；布蘭特原油連續第4個交易日下挫，創6月以來最長跌勢，美國10年期公債殖利率也降至5%以下。避險情緒降溫之際，比特幣同步攀升至約8.5萬美元。
截稿前，道瓊工業指數漲逾 180 點或近 0.4%，那斯達克綜合指數漲逾240點或近 0.9%，標普 500 指數漲近0.6%，費城半導體指數漲近2.1%，台積電ADR漲近1.2%。
美股周一盤前走高，油價連續第4個交易日下跌，加上美中官員在川習會前釋出樂觀訊號，帶動股票與債券同步上漲。標普500指數期貨上漲0.7%，那斯達克100指數期貨勁揚1%，美元持平；美國10年期公債殖利率下滑5個基點至4.95%，比特幣則觸及1月以來新高，推升加密貨幣概念股。
油價回落成為市場風險偏好回升的主要推力。隨著美伊外交斡旋持續，以及中東原油運輸增加，市場對能源價格推升通膨的疑慮略為降溫。美國總統川普表示，本周聯合國大會期間，他「可能」願意與伊朗總統裴澤斯基安(Masoud Pezeshkian)會面。
美軍區域指揮官指出，在美國海軍護航與掃雷行動下，經由荷姆茲海峽運送的原油與液化天然氣已升至6個月來最高水準。另一方面，美中官員也對人工智慧(AI)、貿易及投資談判給予正面評價，替本周四登場的川習會營造樂觀氣氛。
IG首席市場分析師Alexandre Baradez表示，美中談判傳出的回饋，正為本周市場塑造正面敘事，但油價仍是左右行情的最關鍵因素。油氣價格下跌，加上科技股走強，帶動歐洲Stoxx 600指數上漲，歐洲公債表現也優於其他市場。
個股方面，華納兄弟探索(WBD-US)與派拉蒙(PSKY-US)盤前雙雙走高，主因派拉蒙收購華納兄弟案與加州官員之間的和解協商傳出進展。
不過，聯準會(Fed)上周完成2023年以來首次升息後，芝加哥聯準銀行總裁古爾斯比(Austan Goolsbee)警告，供給衝擊反覆出現，恐迫使Fed採取可能造成經濟陣痛的因應措施。在美國零售柴油價格突破每加侖6.5美元之際，他直言，停滯性通膨帶來的就業與物價取捨「只能走一條艱難的路」。
本周美國經濟數據相對清淡，市場焦點包括標普全球公布的9月製造業及服務業採購經理人指數(PMI)初值，以及多名Fed官員談話。彭博策略師認為，在主要央行會議告一段落、布蘭特原油連跌4日，以及美中均有誘因維持談判動能下，市場正面情緒短線可望延續。

items.title: 歐洲光通訊大展開幕！Lumentum攜手高通康寧秀D2D互連  瞄準AI橫向擴展架構  開盤漲超3％
items.title_en: Europe Optical Communications Expo Opens! Lumentum Teams with Qualcomm and Corning to Showcase D2D Interconnects, Targeting AI Horizontal Scale‑up Architecture, Opens Up Over 3%
paras: 一年一度的歐洲光纖通訊展ECOC周一(21日)在西班牙舉辦，美國光通訊大廠Lumentum週一(21日)公佈了與高通及康寧在ECOC 2026上聯合演示的方案，將展示面向AI橫向擴展(scale-up)架構的高密度裸片間(die-to-die)光連，演示將整合高通的D2D介面IP子系統、Lumentum基於VCSEL的光互連平台，以及康寧的多模光纖連接。
三家公司在一份聲明中寫道：「此次演示將展示一種大規模並行的光D2D架構，專為未來的共封裝光學(CPO)和近封裝光學(NPO)實現而設計，支援UCIe等新興的D2D介面。」
聲明還說，透過將高密度D2D連接擴展到跨越數十公尺的光鏈路，同時保持低延遲和低功耗，該架構可實現高度可擴展的頻寬密度，因AI系統正推動互連需求超越當今電氣連接的實際極限。
康寧的多模光纖玻璃插芯(ferrules)將提供演示中所用的高密度光纖連接，凸顯出隨著光鏈路日益逼近計算設備與先進封裝環境，光纖密度的重要性。
Lumentum技術長Matt Sysak說：「這次演示展示了Lumentum的1060 nm VCSEL平台如何將高密度光連接更貼近AI運算。」
康寧周一在美股開盤漲逾2%，Lumentum開漲逾3%，高通漲逾1.5%。
paras_en: The annual European Optical Communications Expo (ECOC) was held on Monday (the 21st) in Spain, and U.S. optical communications giant Lumentum announced on Monday (the 21st) a joint demonstration with Qualcomm and Corning at ECOC 2026. The demo will showcase high‑density die‑to‑die (D2D) optical links for AI horizontal scale‑up architectures, integrating Qualcomm's D2D interface IP subsystem, Lumentum's VCSEL‑based optical interconnect platform, and Corning's multimode fiber connections.

The three companies wrote in a joint statement: "This demonstration will present a massively parallel optical D2D architecture designed for future co‑packaged optics (CPO) and near‑package optics (NPO) implementations, supporting emerging D2D interfaces such as UCIe."

The statement added that by extending high‑density D2D connections across optical links that span tens of meters while maintaining low latency and low power consumption, the architecture can deliver highly scalable bandwidth density, as AI systems are driving interconnect demand beyond the practical limits of today’s electrical connections.

Corning's multimode fiber ferrules will provide the high‑density fiber connections used in the demonstration, highlighting the importance of fiber density as optical links increasingly approach computing devices and advanced packaging environments.
Lumentum Chief Technology Officer Matt Sysak said, "This demonstration shows how Lumentum's 1060‑nm VCSEL platform can bring high‑density optical connections closer to AI computing."
Corning rose more than 2% in U.S. trading on Monday, Lumentum opened up over 3%, and Qualcomm gained more than 1.5%.

items.title: SpaceX納斯達克100權重翻倍至2.82% 被動資金買盤成焦點
items.title_en: SpaceX's Nasdaq-100 Weight Doubles to 2.82% as Passive Fund Buying Becomes Focus
paras: 2026年09月21日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ SpaceX(SPCX-US)週一盤前上漲0.4%至153.38美元，隨Nasdaq-100季度權重調整生效，SpaceX在指數中的權重預估將由1.28%提高至2.82%，增幅超過一倍，被動式基金的調整買盤成為市場焦點。
SpaceX今年6月完成IPO，募資860億美元，成為Nasdaq史上規模最大的IPO，並於7月7日快速納入Nasdaq-100指數。由於上市初期大量股份仍處於閉鎖期，實際可交易的自由流通股有限，因此即使公司市值達2兆美元，初期指數權重仍僅約1.28%。
隨上市後可流通股份增加，本次季度調整後，SpaceX權重預估升至2.82%。Nasdaq資料顯示，目前全球已有超過200項投資產品追蹤Nasdaq-100，相關管理資產超過8,000億美元，因此權重變動將直接影響追蹤指數基金的持股配置。

paras_en: On Monday pre‑market, SpaceX (SPCX‑US) rose 0.4% to $153.38 as the quarterly Nasdaq‑100 weight adjustment took effect, raising its estimated index weight from 1.28% to 2.82% – an increase of more than double – making the adjustment buying by passive funds the market’s focal point.

SpaceX completed its IPO in June, raising $86 billion, the largest IPO in Nasdaq history, and was swiftly added to the Nasdaq‑100 on July 7. Because a large portion of shares remained in a lock‑up period after the listing, the freely tradable float was limited, so even with a market value of $2 trillion the initial index weight was only about 1.28%.

As the float increases post‑listing, the quarterly adjustment now estimates SpaceX’s weight at 2.82%. Nasdaq data show that more than 200 investment products worldwide track the Nasdaq‑100, with assets under management exceeding $800 billion, so the weight change will directly affect the holdings of index‑tracking funds.

items.title: 日本救日元反成賣點！瑞銀資管等再度干預伺機賣出
items.title_en: Japan's Yen Rescue Becomes a Selling Point! UBS Asset Management and Others May Intervene Again to Sell
paras: 瑞銀資產管理(UBS Asset Management)全球主權與貨幣固定收益主管Kevin Zhao表示，若日本政府再度出手干預匯市、拉抬日元，將是賣出日元的好機會。他並不認為日銀上周五升息，意味貨幣政策已明顯轉向鷹派。
Zhao今年稍早原本加碼持有日元，但在美日兩國7月大規模聯手買進日元後賣出部位，如今正等待下一次進場賣出的時機。當時日元兌美元一度貶至約164日元，創40年來最低水準。
日銀上周升息，並宣告貨幣政策已進入「新階段」，但Zhao認為，無論是進一步升息或政府再次干預，都不足以讓投資人相信日元能夠持續走強。他直言，日本維持弱勢日元的根本政策並未改變，美元兌日元接下來可能繼續攀升，日本當局最終仍會再度干預，否則恐怕顏面盡失。
日元本月初一度因市場預期日銀將加快升息而反彈，但上周五升息後支撐有限，匯價再度朝164日元關卡靠近。日本當局隨後向市場參與者進行匯率「詢價」，這項行動通常被視為正式進場買進日元的前兆。
目前交易員押注日銀至明年6月最多還會升息3次，但也預期聯準會(Fed)同期將升息相同次數，意味美日利差未必明顯縮小。Zhao反問，若Fed降息期間美元兌日元都未能大幅回落，如今Fed轉向升息，日元又怎麼可能顯著升值？
Zhao預期，即使日本通膨隨經濟成長升溫，日銀未來幾個月仍會放慢緊縮腳步。日本首相高市早苗延續前首相安倍晉三的「安倍經濟學」路線，堅持透過財政支出支撐經濟。在股市大漲、名目國內生產毛額(GDP)成長及政府債務龐大的情況下，低利率仍符合政府與日銀利益。他強調，「安倍經濟學從來不等於強勢日元」。
paras_en: UBS Asset Management’s global sovereign and currency fixed‑income head Kevin Zhao said that if the Japanese government intervenes again in the FX market to prop up the yen, it would be a good opportunity to sell the yen. He does not believe that the Bank of Japan’s rate hike last Friday signals a clear hawkish shift in monetary policy.

Zhao had increased his yen holdings earlier this year, but sold those positions after the United States and Japan jointly bought large amounts of yen in July. He is now waiting for the next chance to re‑enter and sell. At that time the yen fell to about ¥164 per dollar, its lowest level in 40 years.

The BOJ raised rates last week and announced that monetary policy had entered a “new stage,” but Zhao thinks that whether the BOJ hikes further or the government intervenes again, neither will convince investors that the yen can stay strong. He bluntly says Japan’s fundamental policy of keeping a weak yen has not changed, the dollar‑yen pair may keep climbing, and the authorities will eventually intervene again or risk losing face.

The yen briefly rebounded earlier this month on expectations that the BOJ would accelerate rate hikes, but the support faded after the Friday hike and the exchange rate moved back toward the ¥164 level. Japanese authorities then sent a “price inquiry” to market participants, an action usually seen as a prelude to officially buying yen.

Traders currently bet that the BOJ may raise rates up to three more times by June next year, while also expecting the Fed to raise rates the same number of times, meaning the US‑Japan rate differential may not narrow much. Zhao retorts that if the dollar‑yen pair did not fall significantly during the Fed’s rate‑cut cycle, how could the yen appreciate markedly now that the Fed is back to tightening?

Zhao expects that even if Japanese inflation rises with economic growth, the BOJ will slow its tightening over the next few months. Prime Minister Kishida continues former Prime Minister Abe’s “Abenomics” approach, insisting on fiscal spending to support the economy. With a booming stock market, nominal GDP growth and massive government debt, low rates still suit both the government and the BOJ. He stresses that “Abenomics has never meant a strong yen.”

items.title: 南韓央行啟動24小時韓元交割網路試點
items.title_en: South Korea's Central Bank Launches 24-Hour Won Settlement Network Pilot
paras: 南韓中央銀行(BOK)周一(21日)正式啟動首個24小時韓元交割網路的試營運。此系統於當地時間周一上午9點開始運行，首波由國民銀行(KB Kookmin)、友利銀行(Woori)、韓亞銀行(Hana)與新韓銀行(Shinhan)等四家南韓本土商業銀行率先參與。
在開運首晨約9點30分，兩家參試本土機構成功完成首筆測試交易，金額約為14億韓元(約合100萬美元)。
這項全天候交割機制在工作日實行24小時不間斷運作，僅在周末與國定假日休市。其最大特色在於允許境外外國投資人透過「韓元業務註冊外國機構」(RFI-K)開設的帳戶，在其所在地的當地營業時間直接辦理韓元交易結算與交割，無須親自在南韓境內金融機構開立帳戶。
此舉顯著改善了過去歐美投資人因時差問題而面臨的債券與資產交割延宕困境。
此次試營運為南韓政府推動「韓元國際化路線圖」及外匯改革計畫的重要推手。先前南韓在岸韓元對美元外匯市場已於7月邁入全天候交易，本次交割網路補足了配套支付基礎設施，旨在提升韓元的國際地位，並積極爭取納入 MSCI 發達市場指數。
這一網路預計經約3個月測試後，於2027年1月正式上線營運，屆時將擴大邀請全球主要外資銀行及金融機構全面接入。
paras_en: South Korea's central bank (BOK) officially launched the pilot operation of its first 24‑hour won settlement network on Monday (the 21st). The system began running at 9:00 a.m. local time, with four domestic commercial banks – KB Kookmin, Woori, Hana and Shinhan – participating in the initial wave.

Around 9:30 a.m. on the first morning of operation, two of the participating domestic institutions successfully completed the first test transaction, amounting to roughly 1.4 billion won (about US$1 million).

The round‑the‑clock settlement mechanism operates continuously 24 hours on business days, closing only on weekends and public holidays. Its key feature is that foreign investors can settle and deliver won transactions directly during their own local business hours through accounts opened via the "Registered Foreign Institution for Won Business" (RFI‑K), without needing to open an account at a Korean financial institution.
This move markedly eases the bond and asset settlement delays that European and U.S. investors previously faced due to time‑zone differences.

The pilot supports South Korea's government push for a "Won Internationalisation Roadmap" and foreign‑exchange reform, following the launch of all‑day on‑shore won‑USD trading in July. The new settlement network adds the necessary payment infrastructure to boost the won's global standing and to help secure inclusion in the MSCI Developed Markets index.

The network is expected to undergo about three months of testing before going live in January 2027, at which point it will invite major global foreign banks and financial institutions to connect fully.

paras: 新台幣今(21)日全日維持偏強走勢，終場收在31.758元，升值5分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值擴大至22.67億美元。

觀察主要亞幣，韓元飆升超過1%，新台幣收升0.16%，泰銖升逾0.1%，人民幣升值0.05%上下，星元在平盤附近狹幅震盪，日元則逆勢貶近0.2%，美元指數小跌0.05%左右。
元大投顧認為，聯準會通過升息 1 碼將目標區調高至 3.75%到 4%，也是 2023 年 7 月來首次升息，但聯準會主席華許表示經濟依然強勁，可在不損害就業市場下恢復物價穩定，因此，台股在各項變數漸漸釐清後，可望展開季底作帳行情，惟個股將強弱分明。
統一投顧則指出，上周全球央行周和美日升息後，美國10年債殖利率止漲，緩和通膨擔憂和繼續升息的緊張情緒，而儘管中東地緣政治局勢動盪、國際債市與匯市波動加劇、AI 放緩雜音增多，但整體風險可控，再考量美伊再次出現重啟談判曙光，可提振市場風險偏好。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar stayed on the stronger side throughout the day on the 21st, ending at NT$31.758, a gain of 0.05, with the turnover at Taipei foreign‑exchange brokers expanding to US$2.267 billion.
After opening at NT$31.79, up 0.018, the NTD peaked at NT$31.716, with a daily high‑low range of 0.074.

Among the major Asian currencies, the Korean won surged more than 1%, the NTD rose 0.16%, the Thai baht gained over 0.1%, the Chinese yuan appreciated about 0.05%, the Singapore dollar hovered near flat, the Japanese yen fell about 0.2% against the trend, and the US dollar index slipped roughly 0.05%.

Yuanta Securities believes that the Fed’s 1‑percentage‑point rate hike, raising the target range to 3.75%‑4%, marks the first increase since July 2023. Fed Chair Jerome Powell said the economy remains strong and price stability can be restored without harming the labor market, so after variables are clarified, Taiwan’s stock market could see end‑of‑quarter accounting activity, though individual stocks will show clear winners and losers.

Unified Securities notes that after last week’s global central‑bank meetings and US‑Japan rate hikes, the US 10‑year Treasury yield stalled, easing inflation concerns and the tension over further hikes. Despite geopolitical turbulence in the Middle East, heightened volatility in international bond and FX markets, and growing noise around a slowdown in AI, overall risk remains manageable. Moreover, renewed hopes of renewed US‑Iran talks could boost market risk appetite.

items.title: 升息失望與干預疑慮交織 日元在連假流動性低迷下恐加劇波動
items.title_en: Rate Hike Disappointment and Intervention Concerns Intertwine, Yen May See Heightened Volatility Amid Low Liquidity During Holiday
paras: 日元對美元在上周重挫逾2%後，於周一(21日)盤初暫告企穩，報156.85日元兌1美元。然而，隨著日本「白銀周」到來，交易員擔心，在市場流動性大幅下降後，恐加劇匯率波動。
日本央行上周五雖然將政策利率調升至1.25%，創下31年來新高，然而會中出現2票反對，加上總裁植田和男並未提供明確的未來升息指引，使寄望鷹派立場的投資人感到失望，引發日元走跌，盤中一度下挫1.3%。
隨後市場傳出日本官方進行「匯率檢查」(rate check)，雖稍微收斂跌幅並收於156.88日元，但依然凸顯出匯市強烈的干預疑慮與風險。
目前，日本正逢「白銀周」連續休假，市場交易流動性大幅下降，投資人對官方干預保持高度戒備。分析指出，流動性較低時易引發劇烈波動，但也為當局介入提供放大效果的契機，一如今年4月至5月黃金周期間日元跌破160關卡後的干預舉措。
財務省數據顯示，日本當局於7月下旬至8月26日期間，曾砸下創紀錄的15.4兆日元進行美日協調干預，帶動日元從7月接近164的40年低點，一度強勢反彈至9月初的152.89高峰。
然而，美日央行政策分歧再次為日元帶來下行壓力。聯準會近期發出鷹派訊號，市場預計10月繼續升息的機率升至55%；反觀日央行10月升息的機率，已被掉期市場定價降至20%以下。
監管數據顯示，投機客在日央行會前將日元淨多頭部位推升至97億美元(創2025年7月以來新高)。但在日央行政策指引缺乏明確鷹派訊號的情況下，這批多頭押注正面臨極大回檔風險。
paras_en: The yen slipped more than 2% against the dollar last week, but on Monday (the 21st) it briefly steadied in early trade at 156.85 yen per $1.

Although the Bank of Japan raised its policy rate to 1.25% last Friday – a 31‑year high – two votes were cast against the move and Governor Kazuo Ueda gave no clear guidance on future hikes, leaving investors who had hoped for a hawkish stance disappointed and sending the yen down, at one point falling 1.3% intraday.

Subsequently, reports emerged that Japanese authorities were conducting a “rate check,” which trimmed the decline slightly and closed at 156.88 yen, but the episode still underscored strong market fears of possible intervention.

Japan is currently in the middle of “Silver Week,” a string of holidays that has sharply reduced market liquidity, prompting investors to stay on high alert for official action. Analysts note that low‑liquidity environments can trigger sharp moves, yet they also give authorities a bigger impact if they choose to step in, as seen after the yen fell below the 160‑yen barrier during the gold‑price rally in April‑May this year.

Ministry of Finance data show that Japanese authorities intervened with a record‑breaking 15.4 trillion yen in coordinated US‑Japan action from late July to August 26, lifting the yen from near a 40‑year low of about 164 in July to a strong rebound of 152.89 in early September.

However, policy divergence between the Fed and the BOJ is again weighing on the yen. The Fed’s recent hawkish signals have pushed the market’s odds of another October hike to 55%, while the BOJ’s chance of an October hike has been priced by the swap market at below 20%.

Regulatory data indicate that speculators pushed net long positions on the yen to $9.7 billion ahead of the BOJ meeting – a high not seen since July 2025 – but with the BOJ offering no clear hawkish guidance, those long bets now face a substantial risk of a sharp unwind.

items.title: 川習會前夕中國人行放寬升值干預 人民幣匯率創逾3年半新高
items.title_en: China's Central Bank Eases RMB Appreciation Controls Ahead of Trump‑Xi Summit, RMB Hits Over 3‑Year‑Half High
paras: 在美國總統川普與中國國家主席習近平本周將舉行峰會之際，中國人民銀行放寬了對人民幣升值的限制，帶動人民幣對美元匯率於周一(21日)升至逾3年半以來的新高。
周一早盤，境內人民幣對美元一度觸及 6.6957，創下 2023 年 1 月 16 日以來的最高點；離岸人民幣升至 6.6946。
開盤前，中國人行將人民幣對美元中間價設在 6.7487，雖創下 2023 年 2 月 3 日以來的新高，但仍比《路透》調查的市場預測值弱了 536 個基點。
本次匯率走強適逢美中兩國高層密集會談。美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)與中國國務院副總理何立峰於周日在紐約結束會談，為川普與習近平預計於周四舉行的峰會鋪路。外界預期雙方將討論人工智慧、貿易關係、供應鏈及中東緊張局勢等議題，但分析師預估不會有重大政策突破。
針對人行近期縮小中間價與市場預期差距的舉措，高盛分析師在報告中表示，人行在川習會召開前調強中間價的作法符合近年歷史經驗，這為離岸人民幣現貨價格進一步走強創造了更大空間。
華僑銀行(OCBC)則在報告中指出，較強且相對穩定的人民幣有助於為美中談判創造更有建設性的背景，並減少美方再度指責競爭性貶值的可能性。
然而，華僑銀行也表示，不應將此視為人民幣長期升值周期的開始，並指出：「鑑於美中兩國之間龐大的利差以及中國國內依然疲軟的基本面，近期部分升值可能僅反映了峰會期間由政策維護的穩定性，而非人民幣基本面的重新估值。」
paras_en: As U.S. President Donald Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping prepare to hold a summit this week, the People’s Bank of China has loosened restrictions on RMB appreciation, pushing the RMB‑USD exchange rate up to a new high not seen in over three and a half years on Monday (the 21st).
In early trade on Monday, the onshore RMB briefly touched 6.6957 per dollar, the highest level since Jan. 16, 2023, while offshore RMB rose to 6.6946.
Before the market opened, the PBOC set the RMB‑USD midpoint at 6.7487, a fresh peak since Feb. 3, 2023, yet still 53.6 basis points weaker than the market forecast gathered by Reuters.

The currency rally comes amid intensive high‑level talks between the United States and China. U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Chinese Vice‑Premier He Lifeng concluded talks in New York on Sunday, paving the way for the Trump‑Xi summit slated for Thursday. Observers expect discussions on AI, trade, supply chains and Middle‑East tensions, though analysts doubt any major policy breakthroughs will emerge.

Commenting on the PBOC’s recent narrowing of the gap between the midpoint and market expectations, a Goldman Sachs analyst said that strengthening the midpoint ahead of the summit follows historical patterns and creates more room for offshore RMB spot prices to rise further.

OCBC Bank noted in its report that a stronger and relatively stable RMB helps create a more constructive backdrop for U.S.–China negotiations and reduces the likelihood of the U.S. accusing China of competitive devaluation again.

However, OCBC cautioned that this should not be seen as the start of a long‑term RMB appreciation cycle, stating: “Given the large interest‑rate differential between the United States and China and still‑weak domestic fundamentals in China, the recent modest appreciation may simply reflect policy‑backed stability during the summit period rather than a fundamental re‑valuation of the RMB.”
